scope: Review of photographic layers, tool selection and colour operators
findings_fixed: Sampled colour overlays incorrectly used only the first operator; each overlay now targets its own operator, including after another tool.
Layer mask overlay was inadvertently restricted by the first sampled colour operator; it now displays the mask independently.
additional_guard: Enter in the tool search respects disabled editing while saving; regression passed.
limits: Synthetic PNG does not exercise RAW decoders.
CPU/export agreement is not absolute colour accuracy or display calibration qualification.
Three private-camera tests excluded without TR_RAW_SAMPLE.
Normal photographic blending only; no raster compositing or new R/SF gate conclusion.
